photos.name: img-7701
photos.summary: Boule on a wire cooling rack viewed from a low front angle — single off-center diagonal score has opened into a pronounced ear with exposed pale interior crust, surrounded by deep amber-mahogany flanks with concentric flour-dusted scoring rings curving around the side. Background shows a dim kitchen with a framed painting and white interior door.

photos.name: img-7702
photos.summary: Same boule rotated and shot from a higher angle, fingers visible at lower right holding the rack — the top crown is much darker, nearly burnt-brown and matte where the ear lifted, and the side scoring rings show heavy flour bloom with blistering visible across the lower belly of the loaf.

photos.name: img-7705
photos.summary: Half-loaf cross-section held over a beige tile floor, daylight from the left — crumb is pale cream-yellow with a mix of medium and large irregular holes clustered toward the upper-center and a denser, tighter band along the bottom third. Crust is thin and golden, and a tattooed thumb is visible at the lower left edge.
